faq_heading: Surrey golf course homes: your questions answered

faq.q: How much does a Surrey golf course home cost?
faq.a: Across 94 Surrey sales from November 2025 through October 2026, the golf course median came to $1,405,000, with the middle half between $1,220,000 and $1,600,750. All Surrey detached houses had a median of $1,300,000.

faq.q: What counts as a golf course home in Surrey?
faq.a: In Paragon the agent who lists the house picks Golf Course Nearby or Golf Course Dev. under Site Influences, so Surrey homes beside a fairway and homes a short walk away can both appear.

faq.q: How fast do Surrey golf course homes sell?
faq.a: The median was 32 days on the market, closing at 95.6% of list, with 5% over the list price. All Surrey houses took 33 days.

faq.q: Which Surrey neighbourhoods have the most golf course homes?
faq.a: Fleetwood Tynehead had 35 sales with the flag, East Newton 18 and Bear Creek Green Timbers 8 between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Sold figures come from Paragon closed and pending sales to October 31, 2026. A pending sale is firm but has not completed, so its price can still change. The live search is not connected yet.

Use this search to see Surrey detached houses currently for sale where the listing flags a golf course on the street or nearby. The most golf course sales were in Fleetwood Tynehead (35), East Newton (18) and Bear Creek Green Timbers (8).

Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, Surrey recorded 946 detached house sales, and 94 of them (10%) had the flag. The median was $1,405,000, which is 8% above the $1,300,000 median across all Surrey houses.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a Surrey golf course home

items.t: Find out how far the house is from the course and whether the back or the side faces it. The flag showed up on 94 Surrey sales, so it covers many lots. Fleetwood Tynehead had the most golf-course sales (35).

Order the title search to see whether a right-of-way, covenant or building setback is registered against the lot. The flag appeared on 10% of Surrey house sales, so ask your agent which registered documents apply on Fleetwood Tynehead streets.
Set the price against nearby houses with no flag. The medians were $1,405,000 with it and $1,300,000 without, and floor area and age explain part of that.
